grammar.title: Third Conditional
grammar.explanation:
We use the **third conditional** to imagine a different past. Something did not happen, and we imagine what its result would have been.

The form is **if + had + past participle** in the if clause, and **would have + past participle** in the result.

Use **could have** for something that was possible in the past. Use **might have** when the result was possible but not certain.

You can put the if clause first or second. Use a comma only when the if clause comes first.

Never write **would of**. The short form **would've** means **would have**, and **'d** after if means **had**.

Try it with today's words: if Sara had installed anti-virus software, her computer would have stayed safe.
examples: *If I **had known** about the party, I **would have come**.* (I did not know, so I did not come)
*If it **hadn't rained**, we **would have played** tennis.* (it rained, so we did not play)
*We **would have won** the game if our best player **hadn't been** injured.* (result first, no comma)
*If you **had asked** me, I **could have helped** you.* (could have = it was possible)
*If they **had booked** earlier, they **might have found** a cheaper hotel.* (might have = maybe)
*What **would** you **have done** if you **had missed** the flight?* (a question)

practice.q: Rewrite with the third conditional: I did not install anti-virus software, so my computer got a virus.
practice.a: If I had installed anti-virus software, my computer would not have got a virus.

practice.q: Rewrite with the third conditional: She did not check the attachment, so she missed the mistake.
practice.a: If she had checked the attachment, she would have found the mistake.

practice.q: Rewrite with the third conditional: He did not open the application, so he did not see the message.
practice.a: If he had opened the application, he would have seen the message.

practice.q: Rewrite with the third conditional: I did not know the abbreviation, so I did not understand the email.
practice.a: If I had known the abbreviation, I would have understood the email.
